name: Yamamoto Akuji
source:
The main protagonist of Daiakuji.
Being the successor as the leader of the Wakame yakuza, he received special education, and excels in both literary and military arts.
He deals in all sorts of evil things - rape, torture, extortion, violence, all without guilt, having been raised in a world where survival of the fittest is clear.
